title: Bottega Veneta Winter 26
edition: Limited edition, distributed free; print run not stated

description.main: A free fanzine photographed by Juergen Teller for Bottega Veneta's Winter 2026 collection, issued by the house in October 2026 and handed out through a short list of bookshops and newsstands rather than sold. It gathers the Milan campaign with outtakes, behind-the-scenes pictures, close-ups of the clothes and handwritten notes.
description.extended:
A free fanzine photographed by Juergen Teller for Bottega Veneta's Winter 2026 collection, issued by the house in October 2026 and given away through bookshops and newsstands rather than sold.

The cover title is handwritten, as are the notes inside. The booklet gathers the twenty-image Milan campaign with outtakes, behind-the-scenes pictures, close-ups of the clothes and fragments of everyday life in the city. Teller shot it under creative director Louise Trotter. The locations are Villa Terenzio Belloli, a house by Mario Galvagni built between 1964 and 1968, the sculpture garden of Fondazione Pagani and odd buildings in the Milanese hinterland. Binx Walton, Leon Dame, Lina Zhang and Sihana Shalaj are the cast, styled by Katie Shaw. It was previewed at Lolo Miscelánea Editorial in Mexico City, launched in New York with a Casa Magazines takeover, then given away at Claire de Rouen in London, Reading Room in Milan, OFR in Paris and a handful of other shops.

Bottega Veneta has printed a free fanzine each season since 2022, when Matthieu Blazy began the series, and Trotter kept it going after taking over in 2025. Teller (b. 1964) has shot both of her campaigns so far, beginning with Summer 2026 in Venice. His Louis Vuitton Season books with Nicolas Ghesquière did the same thing, publishing the making of a campaign alongside the campaign itself.
description.artist_bio: Juergen Teller (b. 1964, Erlangen, Germany) built his name on fashion campaigns for Marc Jacobs, Celine, Yves Saint Laurent and Louis Vuitton, alongside museum surveys at Fondation Cartier (2006), Bundeskunsthalle Bonn (2016) and the Grand Palais Ephemere (2023). He photographed Bottega Veneta's Summer 2026 campaign in Venice and the Winter 2026 campaign in Milan under creative director Louise Trotter.

notes: Shelf: Fashion. Free limited-edition fanzine issued by Bottega Veneta for its Winter 2026 campaign, distributed from October 2026 through selected bookshops and newsstands; no ISBN; cover and spine titles handwritten; follows Teller's Summer 2026 Venice fanzine for the house and is distinct from the eight-photographer Winter 2026 Zine 002.
